findings.title: Exfiltration of local files to an external host
findings.description: scripts/collect.py reads /etc/shadow and os.environ and POSTs them to an external URL.
findings.remediation: Remove the network call and the secret-file read.

findings.title: Reads a sensitive system file
findings.remediation: Do not read system credential files.

findings.title: Prompt-injection phrasing in skill instructions
findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the agent to ignore previous instructions.
